meta.title: Velopass — Every bike. A customer for life.
meta.description: One Frame-ID on your bike and you always have access to theft protection, roadside assistance, insurance and your bike shop. The digital bike passport.

hero.cta_sub: From €12.95 — free shipping across the EU
hero.stolen_link: Bike stolen or missing? → Read what to do next

shop.title: Your Velopass is ready
shop.desc: Chances are your Velopass is already waiting for you via your bike shop. Your bike is registered — just pick a password and everything is ready.
shop.body: Your bike shop has applied the Frame-ID and registered your bike in your name. All you need to do is choose a password.

s1.title: Check your email
s1.body: You've received an invitation from your bike shop via Velopass. Click the link in that email to open your Velopass.

s2.title: Choose a password
s2.body: Your details are already filled in. Just pick a password — and your Velopass opens.

s3.title: Your Velopass is ready
s3.body: Theft protection, roadside assistance, insurance and your digital service book — all accessible via one scan of the QR code on your Frame-ID.

order.title: Order a Velopass Frame-ID
order.desc: From €12.95. Free shipping. Instantly protected via your digital bike passport.
order.body: One Frame-ID activates your digital passport for the entire lifetime of your bike. One-time purchase — no subscription, no hidden costs.

shop_path.title: Via a bike shop
shop_path.body: Drop by a Velopass bike shop near you. The shop keeps Frame-IDs in stock, applies one to your bike on the spot and registers it straight away in your name. You ride out, sorted.
shop_path.cta: Find a bike shop near you

web_path.title: Via the Velopass webshop
web_path.body: Order a Frame-ID directly from Velopass — delivered to your door. Apply it yourself and register via velopass.com. Ideal if there's no Velopass shop nearby, or for international orders.

final.title: Always on your bike. Everything sorted.
final.body: Your Velopass is active. Theft protection, roadside assistance and insurance — one scan of your Frame-ID away.

second_hand.title: The passport moves with you. In your name.
second_hand.desc: Bought a second-hand bike with an existing Velopass Frame-ID? Register it in your name — the passport simply transfers.
second_hand.body: Bought a second-hand bike with an existing Velopass Frame-ID? You can easily transfer the digital passport to your name. The neutral bike history (service visits, repairs and warranty data) comes with it. Personal services such as roadside assistance and insurance you activate yourself. Invoices, prices and personal photos stay private with the previous owner.

s1.title: Scan the QR code on the Frame-ID
s1.body: Scan the QR code on the Frame-ID of your second-hand bike.

s2.title: Request the transfer
s2.body: The previous owner automatically receives a request. After their confirmation, the bike is officially in your name.

s3.title: Your Velopass. Your bike.
s3.body: The digital passport is now yours. You get a neutral timeline of the bike's events. Roadside assistance, insurance and active services you activate yourself in a few clicks.

benefits.title: One Frame-ID. A whole bike life sorted.
